quest.title: Roll! A Sea of New Acquaintances
quest.description: With the cast of the dice, a series of duels arise in Liyue. Yet, the enigma behind the scenes grows ever more peculiar...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Invokation Coupons x100, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

chapter.title: Roll! A Sea of New Acquaintances

talks.objective: Go to Liyue Harbor to investigate the Card Snatcher

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Liyue Harbor is still bustling as always.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: "Where merchants flock and all ships dock"... Now I understand what that saying was trying to describe. Still, nothing beats seeing it with your own eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Welcome to Liyue Harbor. I hope you had a smooth journey? Lady Ningguang instructed me to wait for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, it's Ningguang's secretary! Bai... uh, which Bai is it again?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: It's Baiwen. I assist Lady Ningguang with collecting and organizing intelligence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right, Baiwen! Paimon remembers now. The other two are Baishi and Baixiao.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang? You mean Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, that's her. But why does Ningguang want to see us? Wait, and how did she even know that we'd be arriving in Liyue Harbor today!?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang likes to stay informed. Nothing slips through her intelligence network.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: She wishes to invite our visitor from Fontaine, Mademoiselle Charlotte, to join her at Yujing Terrace to discuss cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hmm? What would she want with me? This is the first time I've ever been to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang has known of you for quite some time: a talented and capable journalist with The Steambird who writes insightful, engaging, and — most importantly — factual prose. She rather admires your work.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: She also understands that in revealing the truth through your exclusive news, you have offended some interested parties that have been pulling strings behind the scenes — and that is why you have been sent on an international reporting trip to cover the Genius Invokation TCG events.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what? That's terrible... Poor Charlotte.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: No, no, it's just part of the job. I'm already used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But I'm surprised to learn that Lady Ningguang knows so much about my situation. Does she know my boss or something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon wouldn't be surprised. She seems to know everyone and everything.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang also welcomes the two of you to join, if you're interested.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh? You didn't tell me you were best buddies with Lady Ningguang...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon wouldn't go THAT far... We've just been invited to the Jade Chamber as honored guests a couple of times, y'know...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Enough with the humble-bragging, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, but anyway... if Ningguang wants to discuss work stuff with Charlotte, it's probably gonna be best if we stay out of the way, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe we can go ask around about the Card Snatcher while you have your meeting with Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh, are you sure?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Alright, thanks! Then I'll leave you to it. Let's catch up and swap notes later? I'm actually pretty excited to meet Lady Ningguang, so I don't want to keep her waiting...

response.speaker: Baiwen
response.text: Very well. Please, Mademoiselle Charlotte, follow me.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: See you two later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like Charlotte's a top-notch journalist, huh. Paimon's not sure what that "exclusive" news is all about... but it definitely sounds like a big deal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And if she manages to write up an article about this Card Snatcher case, we'll be featured in her exclusive news, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, it feels like we're about to become famous!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, you're right. Okay, why don't we start asking around at the docks? There's always a lot of people coming and going — maybe someone's seen people trading cards there.

choices.text: Let's just focus on the task at hand.
While we're at it, we can check out our old haunts.

talks.objective: Go to the wharf at Liyue Harbor to ask around for news
Ask people at the wharf for information

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi there! We'd like to ask you about something.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, sure, ask away. The ship's already set sail anyway, so I've got all the time in the world...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you seen anyone around here recently collecting card backs? You know, for that really popular game, Genius Invokation TCG?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Collecting card backs? Hmm... I've definitely seen people around here playing the game, but... I'm usually preoccupied with thinking about the sea, I've never paid too much attention to it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...It's fine, we'll ask someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Ugh... I really can't afford to wake up late next time...

talks.objective: Ask people at the wharf for information

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi there, can we ask you a question?

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Sure, go ahead. I'll a—a—ATCHOO! Answer as best I can.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you noticed anyone here collecting card backs for Genius Invokation TCG recently?

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Card backs? ATCHOO! No, I'm afraid not.

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Sorry, just before, a... ATCHOO! A girl in Inazuman attire walked by and I've... ATCHOO! Been sneezing non-stop since.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, take care of yourself, and get well soon... We'll keep asking around.

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: I'll be alright. While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never... ATCHOO! ...Prevail.

talks.objective: Ask people at the wharf for information

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there. Got a question for ya.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Ah hello, ask away! If it's fish you want, I've got all the answers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, actually it's not about fish. We were just wondering, since you're here all day running your stall, have you seen anyone collecting card backs for Genius Invokation TCG?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Genius Invokation TCG? Hmm, 'fraid I don't know anything 'bout that. People come here for Black-Back Bass, but not card backs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Sorry to bother you, then. We'll try our luck somewhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Don't you wanna buy some fish to take with you? All my fish are "super fresh," you know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, this got off to a slow start. Let's try somewhere else.
Hey, you two. Looking for someone?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon knows that voice... it's Kazuha!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #Nice to see you again, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Captain Beidou needed to return to Liyue to take care of some business, so I've been taking the chance to get to walk around town. It's a nice surprise to run into you two here.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Looks like you have questions. May I be of any help?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, long story short...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Paimon tells Kazuha all that's happened recently...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I see... Well, the harbor breeze is as peaceful and pleasant and as ever. I don't believe that the Card Snatcher you're looking for has been through here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, okay...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I'm not sure if that's good news or bad in your eyes. Oh, by the way, it seems there's a competition being held nearby. I stopped to have a look. This "Genius Invokation TCG"... It seems to be immensely popular at the moment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... Have you never played it before, Kazuha?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: No, I haven't. I have quietly observed from the side.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The Captain brought a small box aboard recently that contained a variety of beautifully illustrated cards. She enjoys playing with the crew, while enjoying a few drinks... a few too many, perhaps.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's called a Casket of Tomes. It's what you use to carry your cards in, and it helps you find players nearby, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You should give it a try, Kazuha! The rules are pretty easy to pick up, and then you'll have a fun game to play with your friends.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is the perfect chance to learn.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hmm, forging friendship through card-based combat does sound quite delightful. Alright then, show me the ropes, if you please.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon can teach you! Paimon's watched {NICKNAME} play a ton of times, so even Paimon's a master invokator now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After we teach you the rules, we'll also have to get you a Casket of Tomes.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But what about this Card Snatcher you're looking for? Is not dealing with that more urgent at present?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, good point... Hehe, Paimon got so caught up chatting with our old friend that she nearly forgot about our promise to our new friend.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Now, where should we go next...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Hey, look over there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't that the Inazuman courier who Diona was chatting with back in Mondstadt? What's she doing here?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ah, I just noticed the logo at her waist. Isn't that Komaniya Express?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Do you know that company, Kazuha?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yes, I've heard of it. They provide delivery services in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Looks like she's having some trouble. Why don't we go and introduce ourselves?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Very well, thank you. Even better now that you're here.

dialogues.text: Hmm, which way is it from here...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there! You look lost, need any help?
Meow! You frightened the life out of me... Huh? Oh, I recognize you... Weren't you at The Cat's Tail in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yep! Paimon's name is Paimon, and these two are {NICKNAME} and Kaedehara Kazuha. It's a strange coincidence running into you again!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Hello, hello... My name's Kirara. I'm a courier for Inazuma's Komaniya Express.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I know Komaniya Express is widely praised for its punctual and safe delivery services. But I wasn't aware that the company had started operating internationally.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Wow, it's rare to meet a fellow Inazuman abroad!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Our company just recently began expanding its services overseas... which is great for me, because now I basically get paid to travel all around the world! Only downside is, I sometimes get a bit lost when it's my first time in a new city...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Sometimes when I'm running late, I even have to change back into my original form and climb over walls to make sure the parcel's on time.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Uh... Do you happen to know the way to the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor? I feel like I've been going in circles all day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we know the place. We'll show you the way.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: You will? Oh, thank you so much!

talks.objective: Show Kirara the way to Wangsheng Funeral Parlor

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: "Down on the ground the dice spin around, while high in the sky the sun shines bright"... Hmm, that last line could use some work...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here we are! This is it.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: #Oh, why it's {NICKNAME} and Paimon! What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: And I see you've brought some... friends? Clients? Business partners? New associates?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahem... Maybe leave the introductions to Paimon. This is Kaedehara Kazuha, and this is Kirara.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hello, it's an honor to meet you.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Greetings, old friends and new. So, what brings you all to Wangsheng Funeral Parlor this fine day?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Wait! Don't tell me — is it our latest promotion? I'm touched that you journeyed all this way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no, we were just giving Kirara directions.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Hello, Ma'am. Are you Director Hu Tao of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor? I'm your Komaniya Express courier, and we have a delivery for you — I just need to ask you for a signature.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Let me see... Ah yes, I've been expecting this.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Delivery services these days make everything so much easier... I used to have to send my consultant running to and fro for this kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Say, Kirara, how flexible is your company in terms of delivering different types of goods? How about a living person? And what about someone who's more in-between alive and dead?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Huh!? Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Her tails are standing up on end...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Guess that's a no... Well, maybe we can talk about potentially expanding your company's services sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: C—Could I trouble you to take a moment and leave a five-star review?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Five stars? That's an odd number... Let's make it an even six! No, much too low — service this good deserves at least eight! In fact, nine: one extra for going the extra mile!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Oh, five stars will be plenty, really... But your enthusiasm means a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Alright, I should be on my way now. Thanks again for the directions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Don't mention it.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Cool! Well, I look forward to seeing you all again soon. Although... hopefully next time it won't be because I'm lost...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I heard you reciting a poem just now, Director Hu. May I ask from where you drew your inspiration?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh? Do you share a liking for poetry as well?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Once in a while, I throw words at each other and see what sticks.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Aiya, there's no need for self-deprecation. I've seen people from all walks of life, and I can tell just from the way your sleeves flutter in the wind that you're a man of culture.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Anyway — I'm preparing for the tournament final that will be held shortly. Anyone feeling poetic? I need ideas.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tournament final? You mean the Genius Invokation TCG tournament?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Yeah, that's the one!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: My next opponent is no small fry. Most of the time he's so unassuming, you couldn't pick him out of a crowd. But during this tournament, it's like he sprang up outta the ground like a Whopperflower and took the competition completely by surprise.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: So I have a strong feeling that this will be a tough battle to win.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then shouldn't you be focusing on your strategy? How is writing poetry gonna help...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Because skill doesn't thrill unless you've also got style!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Lemme give you an example you'd be more familiar with... To make a great dish, it takes not just flavor, but presentation too. Ever heard the saying, "It takes two flints to light a fire"? Same principle applies when you're trying to make an impression.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that sounds like it makes sense... Or does it? Paimon can never tell with Hu Tao...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hmm... In duels to the death, some samurai pay each other respects before the fight. Often, the two opponents find they have much in common.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: See, new guy gets it! What did I say — a man of culture!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: You flatter me, Director Hu. In my humble opinion, you could try incorporating your competitive aspirations into your lines. Or perhaps some words to intimidate your opponent.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh, we have an expert among us! Hey, why don't you play a match with me? It'll help me warm up, and maybe find some creative inspiration.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: As much as I'd like to oblige, I'm afraid that I haven't played before. I don't even have my own deck.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can use my deck.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Perfect! Paimon really wants to watch you play. How about Paimon gives Kazuha a crash course right now?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Since everyone is so willing to offer their help, how can I refuse?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Paimon explains the rules of Genius Invokation TCG to Kazuha...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So there you have it, those are the rules! Paimon also included a few little tips and tricks she's picked up from watching {NICKNAME} play. Well? Think you can handle it from here, Kazuha?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I think I've got it. Thank you, Paimon Sensei.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: S—Sensei? Hehe, wow...! Paimon's never been called that before!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Well, Kazuha? Ready to go one-on-one against Liyue's most notorious backstreet poet?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yes, thank you for the opportunity, Director Hu.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Any last words before the duel begins?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Umm... one moment... Okay, I think I've got something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... that was fast.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Alright! Say your piece, challenger!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, things are really heating up!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Shh!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: "Minds like sharp blades clash, friendship forged through cards and dice, autumn leaves burn bright." I, Kaedehara Kazuha humbly accept this duel.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hehe... "The birds are chirping, the weather's so nice, watch me roll six Pyro dice!" Director Hu of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor is ready for battle!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Bit of a jarring change of genre there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: My turn! Chi~!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Hu Tao and Kazuha play a thrilling match of Genius Invokation TCG...

choices.text: Do you handle all of the deliveries?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: No... Not necessarily. Business has been picking up lately, so the company has hired lots of new staff. But I handle all the international deliveries, because I'm the quickest — I am a youkai, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So chances are that we'll see you on the road again soon.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Ah, I am defeated. It's no wonder that Director Hu has earned a spot in the tournament finals.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Talk about an exciting match, though!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Good thing I was able to "Send Off" of all those Summons of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: I have to say, it's hard to believe that this was your first time playing!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I owe it all to Paimon Sensei's teaching.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You really mean that? Yay, hehe!

choices.text: I agree. Paimon Sensei is the best teacher.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww shucks, now Paimon's embarrassed, hehe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Kazuha, did you enjoy Genius Invokation TCG?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yes indeed, there is a good variety of card abilities, and the tempo of the match can swing in an instant. I understand now why it's become so popular all across Teyvat.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Oh, seems the world's gained yet another TCG player.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Keqing! When did you get here?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Shortly after these two had begun their match. Everyone seemed so focused on the game that I didn't want to interrupt.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: You must be Kaedehara Kazuha? Your reputation precedes you. It's an honor to finally meet you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Please, the honor is all mine. I have heard great things about the esteemed Yuheng from Captain Beidou.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Just call me Keqing. You played very well indeed, considering it was your first time. I'm impressed.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: If we ever have the opportunity, I too would like to play a match with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Kazuha's already lined up his next opponent!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Why so surprised? Practically everyone at Yujing Terrace is playing Genius Invokation TCG these days. I also play from time to time, when time permits.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: #It would be my pleasure to join you for a match. However, I can't borrow {NICKNAME}'s deck forever. Our match might have to wait until after I manage to obtain my own Casket of Tomes.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Oh, that shouldn't be a problem. When we get back to the tournament venue, I'll ask a member of the Genius Invokation TCG Society to provide one for you.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: #And please don't think about returning the favor — I assure you, it's no inconvenience. Besides, a friend of {NICKNAME} is a friend of us all.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I am grateful for your kindness, Keqing.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Pleasure. Also, Hu Tao, the final is about to start. I just came to make sure you're aware.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Don't worry, it might look like my mind's on other things, but I'm still listening!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Thorough preparation is the key to victory, after all!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Will you all be coming with us to the venue?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Actually, there's something we wanted to discuss first...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right! Back to the task at hand...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're investigating a Card Snatcher. Have any of you seen someone going around collecting Genius Invokation card backs recently?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Card backs? You mean like the kind with a treasure chest design on it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, exactly! That's the one!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Funny, the word "snatcher" didn't come to mind when I saw him... He struck me as more of a... potential client.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: I saw him playing a match against Chongyun this morning. He said that whoever lost would have to hand over their card back. It was close, but he managed to beat Chongyun in the end. After the match, he wiped the sweat from his forehead, took the card back from Chongyun, and left.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like we need to go talk to Chongyun, then.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: In that case, try Wuwang Hill. I think that's where he should be.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: If I may ask, what else has this alleged "Card Snatcher" suspected of doing?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... We don't know too much about him, apart from his obsession with Card Backs. But apparently, he's stolen other players' cards before!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I see. I'll inform the Millelith to be on the lookout for this individual, but while he's still at large, make sure you stay safe.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: #I think I'll go with {NICKNAME} to Wuwang Hill.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Alright. See you later.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Good luck in the final, Director.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: With so many people rooting for me, I'm sure the match will be over before I can say "hyu!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's go find Chongyun.

choices.text: And so begins Kazuha's TCG journey.
Look, Paimon Sensei's ego is so inflated, she's floating.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Paimon's always been able to float in the air!

talks.objective: Look for Chongyun at Wuwang Hill

dialogues.speaker: Little Fang
dialogues.text: *sobbing*...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Hey, don't panic! I'm sure we'll find her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chongyun! We found you!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: #Paimon? {NICKNAME}? And...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hello, I am Kaedehara Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Hi, I'm Chongyun, an exorcist from Liyue. Long story short, this boy lost his friend while they were playing Hide-and-Seek.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fang
dialogues.text: *sobbing* ...I told Little Yu not to hide anywhere too far away... But I've looked everywhere, and I still can't find her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, it can be dangerous to get lost out here in the wilderness! We'll help look for her, too. Did you see which direction she went?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fang
dialogues.text: Yeah... I kinda peeked a little bit when I was counting, she went that way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, then let's start looking in that direction.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously, why are we always running into these guys?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Hey everyone, have a look at this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are those Genius Invokation cards?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fang
dialogues.text: Oh! I know that one, it belongs to Little Yu!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fang
dialogues.text: Her dad gave her a deck, and it's her favorite thing. She takes it with her everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Little Yu was definitely here... But there's a fork in the road up ahead. Which way should we go?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm, wait a moment... Did Little Yu's father also give her a small box to store the cards?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fang
dialogues.text: Yeah, a Casket of Tomes. I have one, too.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Oh! Of course! Why didn't I think of that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Right, it can locate nearby players!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. As long as she still has the box with her, we should be able to determine her location.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Quick, get our Casket of Tomes out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... there's Chongyun and Little Fang... Aha! There's another player over there, that must be Little Yu!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fang
dialogues.text: Little Yu!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yu
dialogues.text: Little Fang? *sob* I'm sorry, I shouldn't have gone so far away...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yu
dialogues.text: I was trying to find a hiding place, but then I saw a bunch of really angry-looking guys and I got scared... So I ran and ran till I ended up here. *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we've already taken care of the bad guys.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: But Wuwang Hill is full of yin energy. You shouldn't be playing in a place like this, understand?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fang
dialogues.text: Yes Sir, we won't do it again. Thanks, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yu
dialogues.text: Thank you for rescuing me...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Of course. Now, don't go running off. Hang tight for a moment, and I'll walk you both home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Paimon's glad she was okay.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Me too. Good on Kazuha for coming up with the Casket of Tomes idea.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, how did the rest of us not think of that? Guess we use it so often when we're playing cards that it didn't occur to us to use it for anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a nifty little gadget. The Sumeru scholars who invented it must be super brainy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way Chongyun, we wanted to ask you about something...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Paimon describes the Card Snatcher situation to Chongyun...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Ugh, I knew there was something fishy about his obsession with card backs! I can't believe it... I let a thief slip right through my fingers! Whew, deep breaths... stay calm...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's not your fault. You didn't know what his intentions were.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: If I'd been in your shoes, and he invited me to a duel on the same terms, I doubt I'd have sensed anything untoward either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly. He's crafty. If you're not paying attention, he'll just steal the card he wants, and if that doesn't work, he'll come up with some other way to get his hands on it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Did he happen to say anything after he got the card back?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Not a lot. He seemed to be in a hurry — he just packed up his things and then left for the docks. Hmm... but I did hear him grumbling about how far away Inazuma is, and how he wasn't looking forward to the boat journey.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This guy sure talks to himself a lot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it sounds like a pretty solid lead, so Paimon thinks we should follow it. But first, we should stop by the venue.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Then I guess I'll take Little Fang and Little Yu home now. Though I'd really rather help track down that thief...

choices.text: Don't worry, leave the Card Snatcher to us.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Sure. I'm counting on you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, is it just Paimon, or did things suddenly get gloomier here after Chongyun left? Come on, let's get outta here.

choices.text: You okay? Try not to let it get to you.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Yeah, you're right... When I get back, I should probably meditate for a while to calm myself down. Thanks for your concern.

talks.objective: Return to the Liyue competition venue

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: What an incredible match. Truly mesmerizing to watch two players compete at such a high level.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? We missed the final again? Ugh, Paimon was hoping we'd at least get to catch a glimpse of the final round.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back. Did you find Chongyun? Everything go smoothly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There were a few hiccups along the way, but in the end, it all turned out fine! So, Hu Tao, did you win your match?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Of course! It didn't go quite as "hyu" as I'd expected, but all in all, it was still a good old "wham, bam, I'd like to thank my fam."

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: My opponent was no pushover. We both took out a couple of each other's character cards before it came down to the decisive round.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: I closed my eyes, held my breath, and clenched the dice tightly in my hand as I prayed for the blessings of all my supporters in the audience — both visible and invisible! Wink wink!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Can you guess what happened next?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Channeling all my skill and style, with a flick of the wrist I released the dice from my hands, and shouted my battle cry at the top of my lungs!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Watch me roll six Pyro dice!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: And lo and behold, when the dice came to rest, I counted precisely six of the Pyro persuasion! It was all over before I could say, "Pyre, pyre, pants on fire!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, sounds like your poem worked like a charm!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Director Hu's play style is rapid but graceful, like a lone butterfly navigating the depths of a forest. With a little luck beneath her wings, she soared above the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: #Luck... is a key ingredient in every success. Wouldn't you agree, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's Ningguang and Charlotte! Finished with your business meeting?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Yep! I have to say, the Tianquan has a very incisive mind. She's extremely insightful. I gotta admit, I'm kinda envious of Baiwen now.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh wow, you must be Kaedehara Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Charlotte.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: #First {NICKNAME}, now Kazuha... Feels like I've been inducted into the Teyvat heroes club! I remember when you made the headlines of The Steambird!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: "Young Samurai Blocks the Musou no Hitotachi!" You captured the public imagination in Fontaine for some time.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: My oh my! I had no idea I was up against such a legendary warrior in our card duel earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: That's all in the past now. I count myself as the fortunate one today for this chance to make so many new friends.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Today is indeed a momentous day to have brought us all together. I propose that I treat everyone to a meal to mark the occasion, if it pleases you all?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh? Sounds like it's victory meal time! Count me in!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: You'll have to excuse me for a moment while I wrap up things at the tournament venue. I'll join you all later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is great! We can have a nice, hearty meal and get a good sleep tonight before heading off to Inazuma tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Inazuma? Does this mean you found a new lead on the card snatcher?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure did! Investigating is what we do best! ...Well, okay, guess luck played a part in it too.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I still have some things to take care of here in Liyue, so I'm afraid I won't be able to accompany you to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, but remember to keep working on your Genius Invokation skills. You never know when Paimon Sensei will show up for a surprise inspection!

choices.text: You're getting pretty strict, Paimon Sensei.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I've also heard some things about this card snatcher you're pursuing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Already? Wow, nothing gets past Ningguang, huh...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: A new card back appeared on the market recently. It's extremely rare, and bears an image of a treasure chest.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Some players are willing to pay exorbitant amounts of Mora for things of this nature, as they believe they can improve their luck. So I looked into them briefly to see whether there was any genuine commercial value in them.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I quickly learned that every card back with that particular design had been scooped up overnight. There's not a single one left in all of Liyue.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Initially, I thought this might just be another case of a merchant hoarding goods in hopes of maximizing their profits. But once I heard more, I realized it must be the thief you are after.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Is there anything else unusual about these card backs other than their rarity?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Unfortunately, since I didn't manage to procure one for myself, I'm unable to say for sure.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: All I know is that despite being custom-made, they are not particularly exquisite — if they were, you can be sure I would have purchased one sooner.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Hmm... The mystery of this Card Snatcher gets more baffling at every turn...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It doesn't matter. Given how much he likes to talk to himself, he's sure to spill all his secrets sooner or later.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Every journey into the unknown is a mystery waiting to be solved. But often, it is encounters with the unexpected that make the journey all the more interesting.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: For instance, it was certainly a pleasant surprise for me today to meet top talents from all around Teyvat.

choices.text: You really care for your students, Paimon Sensei.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Little Yu? Little Yuuu, where are you...?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm, a snapped branch and some trampled grass... It looks like the girl was hiding here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess that means we're on the right track. Let's keep going.
